Package au.csiro.pathling.vcl.generated

Interface VclListener

All Superinterfaces:
org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
All Known Implementing Classes:
VclBaseListener
public interface VclListener extends org.antlr.v4.runtime.tree.ParseTreeListener
This interface defines a complete listener for a parse tree produced by VclParser.
